figures.finding: Actors employed at Tjóðpallur Føroya, the national theatre, are paid by the agreement between Tjóðpallur Føroya and Leikarafelag Føroya (in force from 1 May 2009, terminable at three months' notice; listed as current, 'Galdandi', in the Ministry of Finance's register of agreements) on its pay table of 1 October 2024, a month's pay by step: group 1 (on trial or with shorter training) steps 1 to 7, DKK 31,350.51 to 37,661.16; group 2 (four years' training or more) steps 3 to 9, to DKK 39,764.71; a step for each year of seniority in the theatre (§ 5), a 35-hour week, 15% pension on top. The table's period ran to 30 September 2025; the register still lists it as current and lists no later table, and pay rises with the Faroese teachers' agreement (§ 6), so a later raise may stand unpublished.
